intro: Adobe Premiere Pro was rebuilt to meet the needs of today's video editors to produce professional products and features. Some key features of the Premiere Pro editing software include the capabilities below.

servicesHeader.title: ADOBE PREMIERE PRO PRODUCTS AND FEATURES
servicesHeader.description: Video Caddy offers professional Premiere Pro editing powered by industry workflows for production houses and videographers.

services.title: Audio Clip Mixer
items: Audio Clip Mixer adjusts sound clips for more precision and robust audio production, giving the client the highest quality videos.

services.title: Cloud Collaboration
items: Using the cloud means products can be uploaded for instant access to clients located anywhere for real-time feedback and progress reports.

services.title: Timeline Efficiency
items: Timeline allows more efficient editing using intuitive track targeting and shortcuts, providing faster turnaround time on a finished product.

services.title: Multi-cam Editing
items: Multi-cam edits are performed with a streamlined workflow, offering several views of a scene to tell the product story using multiple shots.

services.title: Cross-platform Compatibility
items: Cross-platform compatibility with Apple software speeds up the editing process without spending time converting clips enabling fast turnaround.

services.title: Photoshop Integration
items: Adobe Photoshop files can be opened directly from the video editing software to be edited in Photoshop, allowing clients ease of accessibility.
